why: The reindeer is the gift she gives Gerda, and a calf that stamps a hoof when you are needed is the bravest kind of loyal.

veto.quote: prissiness; the timid and the samey; politeness for its own sake; cruelty passed off as boldness.
veto.why: Keeping the pet out of the painting screen is the timid, polite choice, and her calf belongs where the nerve is.

style: Bold mountain embroidery on felt: every pet wears a stitched, handmade edge with one loud, honest color.
making: Worry: nineteen separate sessions may draw nineteen tidy strangers; let the Lamp send back any sheet too neat to share a family look.
